user_story: As a user, I want to view the list of test cases available on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the functionality being tested. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page title should be 'Automation Practice Website for UI Testing - Test Cases'. 2. The page should display the heading 'Test Cases'. 3. The links for each test case should be visible and clickable, including 'Test Case 1: Register User', 'Test Case 2: Login User with correct email and password', and so on. 4. The page should include a subscription input field with the placeholder 'Your email address' and a button with the text 'Subscribe'.
